originalName: Gratin de pommes de terre à la dauphinoise

source.author: Auguste Escoffier
source.title: A Guide to Modern Cookery (London: William Heinemann, 1907)

pint.read: The source is the English edition printed in London (1907); its pint is taken as the imperial pint of units.json. A judgement.

amount.original: two lbs. of fair-sized Dutch potatoes

sourceNote.en: Fair-sized Dutch potatoes, as the source names them.
sourceNote.de: Mittelgroße Holländische Kartoffeln, wie die Quelle sie nennt.

amount.original: one and one-half pints of boiled milk
four oz. of fresh grated Gruyère

note.en: Some more is sprinkled over the top.

sourceNote.en: The source gives no amount for it.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle nennt dafür keine Menge.

note.en: For buttering the dishes and a few pieces on top.
note.de: Zum Ausbuttern der Formen und einige Stücke obenauf.

text.en: Put them in a bowl and add the salt, the pepper, the nutmeg, the beaten egg, the boiled milk and the cheese.
text.de: In eine Schüssel geben und Salz, Pfeffer, Muskat, das verquirlte Ei, die gekochte Milch und den Käse dazugeben.

text.en: Rub the earthenware dishes with garlic and butter them well.
text.de: Die Auflaufformen aus Steingut mit Knoblauch einreiben und gut ausbuttern.

text.en: Pour the mixture into the dishes.
text.de: Die Masse in die Formen füllen.

text.en: Add a few pieces of butter on top.
Bake in a moderate oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
text.de: Im mäßig heißen Ofen 40 bis 45 Minuten backen.

settled.reason: Our judgement: the source names no number of persons; four, as in the pilot.

check.note: Second check by a reader who did not transcribe it (group fr1). Compared with the 1909 printing of the same book (archive.org b21530142), No. 2222: two lbs of potatoes, one beaten egg (first scan "Qgg"), one and one-half pints of milk, four oz. of Gruyère (first scan "freshj"), forty to forty-five minutes, moderate oven: all agree. No change. Amounts in pints restored on 2026-11-19 after the imperial units were added, read again in the same text.

note.en: The oven is given only as moderate; no temperature is stated.
note.de: Der Ofen wird nur als mäßig heiß angegeben; eine Temperatur nennt die Quelle nicht.
